text: Binance NFT Subscription Mechanism what is the Binance NFT Subscription Mechanism? Binance NFT Subscription Mechanism is a new feature that ensures all participating users stand a fair and equal opportunity to make a successful purchase on Binance nft. There are four phases in the Subscription Mechanism Preparation, Subscription Calculation and Distribution. The final NFT or Mystery Box allocation will be distributed in a fair and square manner. How to Participate in Binance NFT Sales through the Subscription Mechanism Log in to your Binance account and go to the Binance NFT homepage. Click on the NFT Sale banner and you can see all the details. There's a subscription cap for participation tickets. You can only subscribe to certain units of participation tickets. There are four phases in Binance NFT sale 1. Preparation depending on each launch, you need to meet the prerequisite determined by each sale to be qualified to subscribe for participation tickets in the next phase. There are three different types of prerequisites. Let's take the BNB prerequisite as the first example. To be qualified to subscribe for preparation tickets in the next phase, you need to maintain a minimum BNB holding for a certain period of time. We will calculate your average BNB holdings in that period. Your BNB won't be locked at this point. If you do not have enough bnb, you can click Buy More bnb. We have also introduced a new NFT prerequisite as the second type of prerequisite. Users are required to lock the NFTs specified in the NFT Collection prerequisites during the preparation phase. All locked NFTs will be automatically refunded to your wallet at the end of the preparation phase. By doing so, you will be qualified to proceed to the subscription phase where you will be allocated participation tickets to join the Subscription mechanism sale. For the third type of prerequisite, users can choose to fulfill either the BNB or NFT prerequisite. Users must hold a minimum amount of tokens or are required to lock the NFTs specified in the NFT collection prerequisites during the preparation phase to be qualified to proceed to the subscription phase. 2. Subscription Click subscribe for Tickets. You can choose to commit some or all of your available participation tickets. The more tickets you subscribe, the higher the probability of your tickets getting selected. Please note that this does not guarantee you can successfully purchase an NFT from the sale. You will see the amount of tokens you need to look up. Click subscribe. Please note that you can only use the available token balance in your Spot wallet. Your tokens will be locked up until the distribution period ends. 3. Calculation when the subscription period ends, your subscribed participation tickets will enter a pool. The system will select the winners in a fair and square manner. 4. Distribution Once the calculation completes, you will see the allocation details. If you win, you you can use the participation tickets to purchase the NFT assets in the collection. Your locked tokens will be deducted accordingly. If your participation ticket does not win, the locked tokens will be returned to your spot wallet. The NFTs you purchased will be distributed to your account. You can check by clicking Check your NFT Assets or go to Profile User Center NFT Assets get your next NFT from Binance in a fair and equal way today.
